commit: fix(javascript): consistently format strings containing escapes

truth.description: isLoneShortArgument now measures a string by its printed form only when the caller passes measurePrinted, and printTernary in ternary.js still calls it without that option, so under --experimental-ternaries a consequent string with an unnecessary escape before an apostrophe is still judged by its raw length and the same ternary formats differently with and without the escape.

distractions.why: Inside double quotes the backslash before the apostrophe is an unnecessary escape, so this string has the same value as the one on line 2 and only its source width differs, which is what the test needs.
